definitions.explanation: a formal notice or form submitted when arriving late to work or school

examples.japanese: {遅刻届|ちこくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit a late arrival notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{遅刻届|ちこくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a late arrival notice because the train was delayed.

examples.japanese: {遅刻届|ちこくとどけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fill in the reason on the late arrival notice.

notes:
{遅刻届|ちこくとどけ} is a compound noun combining ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧ (being late) + {届|とどけ} (notice/notification), referring to the formal documentation required when arriving late.

WORKPLACE DOCUMENTS (～{届|とどけ}):
- {遅刻届|ちこくとどけ} (late arrival notice)
- {早退届|そうたいとどけ} (early departure notice)
- {欠勤届|けっきんとどけ} (absence notice)
- {休暇届|きゅうかとどけ} (leave request form)
- ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧ (resignation notice)

TRAIN DELAYS:
When trains are delayed in Japan, stations provide {遅延証明書|ちえんしょうめいしょ} (delay certificates) that can be attached to {遅刻届|ちこくとどけ} to verify the reason for lateness.

SCHOOL CONTEXT:
Students may also need to submit {遅刻届|ちこくとどけ} to their homeroom teacher or school office.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遅刻届|ちこくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧/⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a late notice)
- {遅刻届|ちこくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a late notice)

REGISTER: Neutral to formal. Standard workplace/school vocabulary.
